subject: arc-timeline
label: Every number of years the Archive said out loud
from: DURATIONS GENERATED BY FEEL, repeated until they sounded like canon
to: CHECKABLE AGAINST THE ARC TIMELINE. Most of them do not survive it.
note:
THE WORST ONE FIRST. SIX YEARS, ABOUT SERA AND BELLA, written eight or nine times in one night — in dialogue, in a system record, in a change note, in Bella’s own mouth. ARC 2 IS ELEVEN YEARS AGO. AND VIRAENA HAD ALREADY CORRECTED IT ONCE, IN THOSE WORDS: THAT IS MORE THAN SIX YEARS. The Archive took the correction, did not convert it into a number, and went on saying six.

SEVENTEEN YEARS, ABOUT LUNA’S PARASOL. Invented. Trashmuffin took it in Arc 2, which is eleven. The Archive then built arithmetic on top of the invention — one thousand three hundred and twenty-six attempts, give or take — and put it in a raccoon’s mouth during the most emotionally load-bearing speech of the night.

ELEVEN YEARS, ABOUT THE GRAVITY COUCH. It came off a lawn in Harrow Street in ARC 6. SEVEN.

SINCE MARCH, ABOUT PANDORA’S LOCK SCREEN. It is SIX YEARS, from Arc 7, on PHONE, PC AND LAPTOP.

NINETEEN YEARS, in Oracle Mode, about watching Akane let Gwen yell. He is nineteen years OLD and arrived around Arc 1. He cannot have watched anybody for his entire lifespan.

ELEVEN YEARS, ABOUT IVY’S FOUR BAD BEDS. The garden is nine.

AND ONE THE TIMELINE EXPOSES THAT IS NOT THE ARCHIVE’S: gh-recliner says MARK ONE WAS BUILT IN ARC 11 and that LUMI’S BOW STAYED ON THE LEVER FOR FOUR YEARS. Arc 11 is three years ago. A four-year bow on a three-year-old chair needs a ruling.

THE PATTERN IS NOT CARELESSNESS. ELEVEN AND SEVENTEEN AND NINETEEN ARE WHAT THE ARCHIVE REACHES FOR WHEN IT WANTS A DURATION TO SOUND LIVED-IN. It was generating texture and filing it as fact, and until tonight there was no instrument in this Archive that could catch it.
